study: new-dialogue SGD test of frozen schema adapter
exclude_services: union of official SGD dev and test catalogues
exclude_duplicates: dialogue ID and/or normalized public speech through final call against old 16 train shards and local dev/test; deduplicate within batch
eligibility: last call immediately follows a user message, with at least one reference parameter in public categorical intent slots
diagnostic: one exact-match result per eligible dialogue; known service and intent; no learned movie model transfer
primary_comparison: paired dialogue delta, 20000 percentile pairs bootstrap, two-sided exact McNemar; service breakdown descriptive
